The quality has plummeted. Most of the doctors are great IF you manage to get an appointment.

But the problem is, everybody rings at 9 - there is no to scant triage, so people are booked in on first in first out bases. That means that you can have a complaint that can wait but, if they have availability, they'll book you in. On the other hand, if your complaint is serious but you are "too late" you're on your own.

All the calls should be taken, triaged, and THEN assigned. At 9:45 all the visits are assigned already - it's a joke.

Once you manage to get an appointment, the doctors are (mostly) great. The practice manager is responsible for how poorly the rating have gone. If you don't have nurses for triage, hire some, and organize the practice accordingly. This way of running the practice is a disservice to the
